input: Research international pen pal programs for my teenager

keyUnknowns.whyItMatters: The teenager's age, gender, and any specific identity factors affect which programs are age-appropriate, safe, and a good social fit.
Whether the goal is traditional letter writing, email, or digital/social messaging changes which platforms and programs are relevant.
Whether there is a specific country, language, or region the teen wants to connect with narrows the search dramatically.
Whether the teen has a particular interest or topic (e.g. language learning, a hobby, school project) shapes which programs are the best match.
Whether free programs are required or a paid/premium service is acceptable affects which options can realistically be recommended.
Knowing whether safety/moderation features, structured curriculum, or simply a large active community is the top priority determines how to rank and compare programs.
Whether the parent or the teenager will be managing the account and correspondence affects what level of parental oversight or supervision tools are needed.

gold.taskTitle: Research international pen pal programs for teenager
gold.taskDescription: Find and evaluate international pen pal programs suitable for a teenager to connect with peers abroad.

questions.title: How old is your teenager specifically?
questions.description: The teen's exact age determines which programs are age-appropriate and whether parental consent requirements apply.

questions.title: Should the correspondence be letters, email, or digital messaging?
questions.description: The preferred format (physical mail, email, or app-based chat) determines the entire category of programs to research.

questions.title: Is there a specific country or language they want to connect with?
questions.description: A target region or language narrows the search to programs that can match with peers in that area.

questions.title: Does your teen have a particular interest driving this, like language learning?
questions.description: A motivating interest (e.g. learning Spanish, a school assignment, a shared hobby) points toward specialized programs that align with that goal.

questions.title: Is a free program required, or is a paid service acceptable?
questions.description: Budget constraints determine whether premium, subscription-based platforms should be included or excluded from the research.

questions.title: What matters most: safety moderation, curriculum structure, or community size?
questions.description: Knowing the top priority allows programs to be ranked and compared by the factor that matters most to the family.

questions.title: Will you as the parent be supervising the account and messages?
questions.description: The level of intended parental oversight determines whether programs need built-in monitoring tools or parental dashboard features.
